GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly, not bustled early and allowed to drift back, Settled Down 7 Lengths on fence, railed up to 3.5 Lengths turning, Held Up home turn to 250m then shifted Two Wide and worked into the race, switched back to rail after passing original leader, chopped out at the 50m. Third over line and promoted to 2nd on protest. # Had excuses
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: From passing the 400m until near the 250m, was held up for a run. Checked and lost rightful running approaching 100m. Successfully protested against winner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 2 Lengths 2-3 wide, out 3 Wide at 1600m, in Two Wide at 1300m, Moved Up to Two Wide joint Lead turning, hit Lead 350m, Headed 275m, kept trying to post # winner too good
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide until the 1300m. Laid out under pressure in the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Not Bustled why?? mapped to at least box-seat if not lead with no weight, Settled Down 6th Inside 4 Lengths off leader/winner No Pace On ! and had Nowhere To Go Until 400m, battled on to line (w/off) # wrong move early
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Held up for clear running round home turn.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok comf Went Forward sit 2nd Outside 1/2 Lengths happy to stalk to Turn , given slip Soon After Straightening Up Just Kept Going One Pace - # had its chance

Jumped Ok Went Forward from Outside to be = Lead 3 Wide x 1200m, Soon After sat 2nd Outside faced breeze To The Turn Under Pressure Turning for home flat @ 200m, couldn't finish off - faced # breeze, fitter
Bit Slow Out Settled Down 7th Outside 5 Lengths Ridden Along x 600m, couldn't quicken Drifted Back rear @ Turn clear run home Outside quickened from the 200m, ran on # strong late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When laying in approaching the 500m, steadied when close to heels and shifted out.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 2 Lengths Four Wide , pressed on and took Lead out Wide at 1400m, went clear and crossed 1250m, Held Together in front & led 2 Lengths turning, Headed at 120m, kept battling to post # worked hard early

Jumped awkwardly missing start 1 length & Settled Down 3 Lengths on fence, held together much same to turn 2.5 Lengths rail, blocked 400m, shifted out 320m & hooked around eventual winner's heels, kept coming to the line # battled on ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Near the 400m, when attempting to improve between runners, then shifted in and as result was disappointed for that run and was obliged to shift out across heels to obtain clear running.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 2 Lengths Two Wide , Moved Up to 1 length Two Wide turning, kept trying but couldn't go with the leader/winner down the straight. [Stewards: Raced keenly early stages.] # winner too good
Jumped well settled Outside Leader no speed on (1200m), no change 600, cornered now Ridden Along Under Pressure , Under Whip Soon After faded last 150 # sat 2nd/leader won
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keen early. Rdr reported mare may not have run out the 1600m. A post-race vet exam revealed no abs.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 1.5 Lengths on fence, held together much same to turn 2 Lengths rail, shifted off heels Straightening Up and Moved Up to join Lead at the 250m, Headed 200m, kept trying but couldn't raise any extra effort. (Nasal Strip FIRST TIME, Winkers FIRST TIME) # battled on fairly
